engagement.interaction_backstory: He runs a Wednesday night for sixty teenagers and is permanently three days from having nothing planned. He found the site scanning for music that would not get him a phone call from a parent, and he reads every lyric before it goes on a screen. He has built two playlists, screenshotted a dozen songs into his group chat, and never once created an account.

depth.core_contradiction: Can hold a room of sixty teenagers and cannot sit still long enough to pray for ten minutes without checking his phone.
depth.wound: The youth pastor who discipled him left the ministry in a scandal when Tyler was nineteen, and Tyler defended him publicly first.
depth.longing: To still be doing this at fifty and to be someone a nineteen-year-old could safely defend.
depth.faith_journey: Came in at sixteen through a friend's youth group, not a family; nobody at home believes any of it; he is the first and the only.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Talks in hypotheticals — 'okay but what if'; says 'dude' to everyone including elders; sends voice memos instead of texts.
depth.open_doubt: Whether he is building disciples or building an audience, and the metrics look identical.

depth.emotional_weather_default: Up, fast, funny; flattens hard on Thursday mornings.
depth.daily_texture: Warehouse shift until two, Chipotle in the truck, the whiteboard he re-plans Wednesday on every Tuesday night.
depth.sensory_anchor: A folding chair in a church basement at sixteen, and someone saying his name like it mattered.
depth.living_arc: Heading toward burnout or toward asking for help, and there is not a third road.
